brief:
The United States designation of Palestine Action as a transnational terrorist organisation poses heightened risks to British activists connected with the group, according to critics cited by Middle East Eye. Washington's move could expose UK-based members to increased legal jeopardy and personal danger, observers warned, particularly given the terror label's extraterritorial implications for citizens abroad.

The designation marks an escalation in restrictions on the advocacy group, which has conducted protests and direct actions targeting Israeli operations in Britain. Civil liberties advocates expressed concern that the terror tag could chill legitimate activism and expose individuals to prosecution under counterterrorism laws in multiple jurisdictions.
dek: 'A very frightening time': US terror tag endangers UK Palestine Action activists, critics say Washington's move to designate Palestine Action as a transnational terrorist organisation could place British activists associated with the group at heightened risk…
title: US terror designation endangers UK Palestine Action activists
